title: Text to Speech with Amazon Polly [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this new hands-on tutorial on this time text to speech with Amazon Polly.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到 Amazon Polly 文字轉語音實作。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's go to the search bar.
cues.zh: 到搜尋列。

cues.en: Let's enter Polly here and we're gonna enter Amazon Polly to turn text into lifelike speech.
cues.zh: 輸入 Polly，進 Amazon Polly，將文字轉成逼真語音。

cues.en: Alright, here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Welcome to Amazon Polly to turn text into lifelike speech using deep learning.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到 Polly，利用深度學習將文字轉逼真語音。

cues.en: Okay, so it's actually state of the art text to speech.
cues.zh: 是先進的文字轉語音技術。

cues.en: And so here we go, let's try Polly.
cues.zh: 試試 Polly。

cues.en: Alright, so to turn text into speech, we have the choice between four different engines.
cues.zh: 四種不同引擎可選。

cues.en: First, generative that produces the most expressive and adaptive speech using generative ai.
cues.zh: Generative，用生成式 AI 產生最有表現力、適應性的語音。

cues.en: Or you have long form which produces the most natural sounding speech.
cues.zh: Long-form，產生最自然的長內容語音。

cues.en: For longer content, you have neural which produces natural and human-like speech, more natural than standard engine.
cues.zh: Neural，產生比 Standard 更自然、像人類的語音。

cues.en: And you have standard which produces natural sounding speech.
cues.zh: Standard，也產生自然語音。

cues.en: Okay, so which one do you want to go with?
cues.zh: 選哪種？

cues.en: Well, let's go for the best.
cues.zh: 選最好的。

cues.en: It seems to be the most expressive and adaptive speech using generative ai.
cues.zh: 看來是使用生成式 AI、最有表現力與適應性的。

cues.en: And besides since we are in the era of generative ai, well let's go for this one.
cues.zh: 既然生成式 AI 時代，就用它。

cues.en: And now of course we can choose a language.
cues.zh: 當然可選語言。

cues.en: So let's keep American English and you can even choose a voice between some female voices like Danielle, Joanna, Ruth,
cues.zh: 保留美式英語，聲音可選 Danielle、Joanna、Ruth、

cues.en: Sally, or some male voices between Matthew or Stefan.
cues.zh: Sally 等女聲，或 Matthew、Stefan 等男聲。

cues.en: Okay, well I actually have a friend called Stefan, so I'm gonna choose Stefan and well, we're not gonna use the default input text once again, I'm gonna write our little signature here,
cues.zh: 我有朋友叫 Stefan，所以選他。不用預設文字，再輸入我們的小招牌句，

cues.en: so I'm gonna say hello my friends, and then enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: Hello my friends，再 Enjoy the cloud。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: Alright, and then to convert this text into speech, you simply have to click listen here and hello my friends, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 要轉語音，只要按 Listen，聽：「朋友們好，享受雲端的樂趣吧。」

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: That was our little signature spoken by Stephan.
cues.zh: 這就是 Stefan 說的招牌句。

cues.en: And now let's try a female voice.
cues.zh: 試女聲。

cues.en: So this time I actually have a friend, a female friend called Sally.
cues.zh: 我也有女性朋友叫 Sally。

cues.en: So I'm gonna choose Sally here, but feel free to try the other voices and let's have Sally say the same thing.
cues.zh: 所以選 Sally，也可以試其他聲音。讓她說同樣的話。

cues.en: Hello my friends, enjoy the cloud and listen.
cues.zh: Hello my friends, enjoy the cloud，按 Listen。

cues.en: Hello my friends, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 「朋友們好，享受雲端的樂趣吧。」

cues.en: Wow, I like that pretty much actually that was a pretty nice voice and kind of a futuristic way to say, hello my friends enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 哇，很喜歡，聲音不錯，說這句有未來感。

cues.en: Definitely pretty far from how I say it.
cues.zh: 和我的說法很不一樣。

cues.en: Lemme know if you agree, lemme know also your favorite voice in the comments.
cues.zh: 告訴我同不同意，也在留言說最喜歡哪個聲音。

cues.en: And that's it.
cues.zh: 就這樣。

cues.en: That's it for this hands-on tutorial on text to speech with Amazon Polly for the exam.
cues.zh: Polly 文字轉語音實作到此。

cues.en: Actually the only and most important thing to remember is that text to speech is done with Amazon Polly.
cues.zh: 考試唯一最重要的是記住，文字轉語音用 Amazon Polly。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待下一堂實作見。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
